title:
SMART COLORS Brand Rebuild
Product Experience & Launch
description:
SMART COLORS is a B2B Shopify application by TETRACHROM that helps online retailers improve product discovery through accurate, AI powered color search. I was contracted to lead the full rebrand and establish a cohesive visual direction across the brand, product, marketing, and investor experience. A key part of the rebrand was restructuring the typography system so the product could communicate technical accuracy while remaining clear, lightweight, and approachable.

I designed the primary product interface and collaborated on its user experience, user flows, and interaction logic. The broader engagement included the complete marketing website and waitlist page, feature graphics, a custom icon set, Shopify App Store assets, a 15 page pitch deck, a rich text email signature delivered for direct copy and paste use, a LinkedIn banner, and a future customer KPI dashboard built around Shopify's component library and interface standards. I also created a 90 second motion graphic product demo from the ground up, developing the storyboard, pacing, graphic system, interface mockups, animation, and music sequence as one continuous product narrative.
concept: SMART COLORS is designed as a lightweight tool that integrates naturally into a retailer's existing Shopify experience. The visual system uses white space as a neutral field, allowing accurate search results, product colors, and the spectrum inside the color dialog to remain the clearest and most expressive elements across the brand and interface.
